notes:
### Changed
- **Update manifests now live in `ImLogueybear/PocketAppsTCG` under
  `pocketvaulttcg/`.** The app polls
  `pocketvaulttcg/updates.json` on `main`, and releases publish an immutable
  `versions/<tag>.json` snapshot there. Installers that still poll the old
  `PKMNDB/app-data/updates.json` get the same manifest mirrored for the
  transition.
- The manifest now carries the Android `build` (versionCode); the checker
  compares it first and falls back to semver `version`.

No scan-index rebuild required (no descriptor or card-data change).
